_comment: Single source of truth for Two-Minute Tuesday brand colors. Change these six values and re-run the episode's make_video.py and build_demo_workbook.py to restyle everything. The Excel UI itself (its green, its greys, its blue spill borders) is deliberately NOT themed -- recoloring Excel's own chrome makes a screencast look fake.

_roles.dark: Title and recap card background. The deepest brand tone.
_roles.accent: Card accent bar, series name, recap numbers. One bright brand color.
_roles.header: Table header fill and report label text.
_roles.tint: Table row stripe. A very light wash of `header`.
_roles.input: The editable cell on the report. A very light wash of `accent`.
_roles.muted: Secondary text on the cards. Must stay readable on `dark`.
